summary: Internal development admission protocol (OWNER-CHALLENGE-ADMISSION-01 as amended 2026-10-01): never mainnet, not miner-facing, not a qualification gate; miners see only the final optimized version. Review moves from every change to every finding. Track A records every construction expansion without per-change review; an emitted finding (score-value divergence, gate anomaly, failing trigger) stops widening, and acceptance is one lock of a recorded state bound to both ledgers. Track B full review only at STUCK, WINNING or OWNER_REQUEST. The admission validator refuses empty, failed, inconclusive, stale or tampered evidence by digest; the readiness-record wiring (schema v3 records, launch gate, --require-admission) lands with #458, so that gate is specified, not enforced, and launch approval stays human-reserved. The divergence detector fires on EV2's boundary-optimist control; the progress noise band is derived from retained seed repeats (EV2 tau band 0.260). Read-only EV1/EV2 audit keeps its caveats; the design optimizer is scoped, not built. No challenge is accepted and no miner-code capability or runtime interlock is enabled.
